name: Thread the Needle Stretch
steps: Start on all fours in tabletop position on a comfortable mat.
Lift your right hand and slide your right arm under your chest across to the left, with your palm facing up.
Lower your right shoulder and right temple gently down to rest on the mat, looking toward your left.
Feel a deep, pleasant stretch between your shoulder blades and through your upper back.
Hold for 3 to 5 seconds, press back up to tabletop through your left hand, and repeat on the opposite side.
coaching_cues: Keep your hips centered directly above your knees as you thread your arm through.
Do not force your shoulder to the floor if mobility is limited; use a pillow under your shoulder if needed.
Breathe deeply into your upper ribcage.
